verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago publishes an official MCP server with a dedicated first-party docs page, confirmed by the probe. Its documented tools let an agent search official documentation, create test users and manage their funds, and configure and monitor webhook notifications from the IDE. Missing for 10: setup, auth, and transport details or a list of supported clients, evidence of MCP tools for live payment operations beyond developer and testing workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
